name: CNY reference amount
note: Uses Treasury's published 2026-09-30 reporting rate. Not an executable quote and not necessarily the tax transaction-date rate.

name: USD basis of disposed CNY lot
formula: documented USD basis of the specific CNY lot disposed of
note: Do not substitute the current balance or current exchange rate. Acquisition by purchase, income, gift or inheritance can require different basis evidence.

name: Realized currency gain or loss
formula: USD value of CNY disposed at disposition − USD basis of the same CNY lot
note: Compute lot by lot. Execution fees are tracked separately unless tax advice establishes a different treatment.

name: Personal currency gain recognition
formula: if personal transaction and 0 ≤ gain ≤ $200: recognized gain = $0; if personal transaction and gain > $200: report the gain as capital gain
note: The $200 test is per qualifying personal disposition. Above $200, the exclusion does not apply; do not tax only the excess over $200.

name: Personal currency loss
formula: no deduction assumed for a personal-use loss; test §165(c) and capital-loss limits if facts differ
note: A loss is not automatically a refund or offset.

name: Nonpersonal currency gain or loss
formula: generally ordinary under §988 unless an exception or valid election applies
note: Business, investment/income-producing use, functional currency and elections must be established.

name: U.S. federal tax
formula: taxable gain × applicable rate, after tax year, filing status, taxable income, character and credit limitations are established
note: No flat conversion-tax rate is applied. Foreign tax credits are limited and do not automatically equal PRC tax paid.

name: Execution fees
formula: sender fee + intermediary fee + receiver fee + FX spread cost
note: No executable provider quote was supplied. Treasury reporting rates do not verify commercial spread or fees.

name: Total workbook cost
formula: U.S. federal tax + execution fees + other verified costs or penalties
note: Remains blank while any required component is unverified. Reporting penalties are fact-dependent and not estimated here.
